fees.notes: International student tuition: RM82,500 total. Source: https://www.uniten.edu.my/programme/undergraduate/bachelor-in-computer-science-network-engineering-honours/ (UNITEN official programme page, accessed 2026-09-18). UNITEN International Undergraduate Fee Structure (Dec 2024) listed RM78,000. per_year = total / 3yr nominal duration.

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 46 (iBT) or MUET Band 3.5; Intensive English Programme (IEP) required if requirement is not met.
requirements.other_qualifications: STPM with minimum CGPA 2.00 and Grade C in Mathematics; or A-Level with minimum Grade D in Mathematics and a Science/Technology/Engineering subject; or International Baccalaureate with minimum 24 points; or Foundation/Matriculation/STAM in a related field with minimum CGPA 2.00.
